facts.value: The Study Service Point and the hotline are your central points of contact for questions regarding studies, applications, and student administration.
Central academic advising supports you competently with all concerns related to studying.
The student secretariat is your reliable point of contact for all questions regarding the organization of your studies.
You will find contacts for all formal matters regarding your study achievements in the examination offices, including Bachelor's thesis, exam registration, or certificates.
From the application to graduation, Goethe University supports international students with comprehensive advising and service offers throughout their entire journey.

The PBS provides you with support and a listening ear for personal concerns. In addition to individual talks, the PBS offers online lectures and workshops each semester on topics such as self-reflection, resilience, and stress management.

The PSB supports students with personal and study-related challenges, such as anxiety, loneliness, relationship stress, or learning blockages. In addition to individual and couple counseling, there are also group offerings.

In addition to a diverse sports program, the university's sports also offers courses and videos on stress management and self-assertion, as well as events to actively get involved and meet new people.

The Career Service supports students and alumni (up to 1 year after graduation) in entering the job market. Strengthen your career competencies through workshops, coaching, and networks. Free, practical, and individual – your springboard into the job.
Goethe University promotes an equitable and discrimination-critical environment and stands for equality, diversity, and inclusion.
Advising in cases of discrimination as well as measures for prevention and reduction of discrimination.
The ombudspersons are your contact person for problems, complaints, or improvement suggestions related to studies and promotion.
The scholarship service supports students and employees from all fields. Find your scholarship and benefit from individual advising!
The student services offer affordable housing near campus. Discover numerous dormitories, learn about rent prices, and apply directly online for your room.
BAföG, scholarships, part-time jobs, or loans – the student services in Frankfurt inform about all possibilities of study financing and provide individual advising.
With our newsletter for students, parents, and teachers, and on our social media channels, we regularly inform you about the student offers of Goethe University.
